profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at ZBD
profile.summary: Results-driven Software Engineer with extensive experience in payments and payout systems, specializing in Golang and large-scale financial integrations. Proven track record of designing, implementing, and optimizing mission-critical payment architectures handling millions of transactions monthly. Skilled in system design, distributed systems, and API integration across payment processors, fraud detection, tax, and compliance services. Recognized for technical leadership, mentoring backend engineering teams, and driving initiatives that elevate engineering excellence and knowledge-sharing. Adept at collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver secure, compliant, and user-focused financial solutions that power global operations.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Directly involved in preliminary design discussions with various stakeholders on upcoming projects, which greatly impacts priority since I'm able to accurately describe the work. I accomplish this by understanding stakeholder needs and explicitly defining the necessary context and scope. This process allows the group to discuss necessary trade-offs and expectations. These discussions have significantly improved my ability to see the bigger picture and how different stakeholders are affected by engineering decisions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for designing and developing systems critical to our payment, payout, and refund capabilities. This involved integrating with 3rd-party vendors and communicating with various stakeholders within the company. Working on this system indirectly touched other systems related to payments such as fraud, KYC/KYB, and account management.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Sole developer responsible for maintaining and developing new features for Second Life's billing engine. Critical projects included credit card data migrations, 3rd-party PSP integrations, and development of payment-related internal tools. Since I was the only developer, I was the primary contact for all billing-related outages.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: When I started at Linden Lab, I have developed amazing new features for the Desura.com website using PHP and CodeIgniter. My major accomplishment was developing a customizable widget to allow customers to buy games directly from developer's websites. I also designed and developed a monthly sale promotion called Cheap End.

positions.title: Laboratory Technician
positions.locationName: University of Hawaii at Manoa · On-site
positions.description: I was primarily responsible for managing the 5000+ DNA and genotyping customer samples to be run on the ABI 3730xl DNA Analyzer. I also performed sequencing runs on Next Generation Sequencing technologies like the Roche 454 GS FLX+ and Ion Torrent PGM systems.

company.name: Advanced Studies in Genomics, Proteomics, and Bioinformatics

publications.title: Draft genome sequence of the rubber tree Hevea brasiliensis
